fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-06-18, the complainant reported repeated harassment by a neighbour over a minor road collision near Nallur Garden Residential Colony in Coimbatore. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-06-17 at approximately 22:40. Bharathi Ammal approached Coimbatore North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000228. Bharathi Raj (mobile 9000000191) was named as a possible person of interest. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and social media screenshots. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00082, as the mobile number 9000000191 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Neighbour allegedly used abusive language during a continuing dispute.
